name: Remittance Information 1
definition: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, eg, commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system.

Unstructured.name: Unstructured
Unstructured.definition: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, eg, commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system in an unstructured form.

Structured.name: Structured
Structured.definition: Information supplied to enable the matching of an entry with the items that the transfer is intended to settle, eg, commercial invoices in an accounts' receivable system in a structured form.
